title: Whale waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#1a4d7a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0d2b4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ocean body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='40' ry='26' fill='#2a6fa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='38' ry='16' fill='#1d5580'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='74' rx='30' ry='10' fill='#8fd0f0'/>
  <!-- mouth line -->
  <path d='M20 66 Q40 74 62 70' stroke='#123a5c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='56' r='5' fill='#0b2035'/>
  <circle cx='33.5' cy='54.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M88 46 Q98 34 94 24 Q86 30 84 40 Q88 32 92 26 Q96 36 88 46 Z' fill='#2a6fa8'/>

  <path d='M46 36 Q44 24 38 18' stroke='#9be8ff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='38' cy='16' r='3' fill='#c8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='14' r='3' fill='#c8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='20' r='3' fill='#c8f4ff'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin (waving arm) -->
  <path d='M24 60 Q10 44 4 30 Q12 30 18 38 Q22 44 26 54 Z' fill='#2a6fa8'/>
  <!-- fin highlight -->
  <path d='M10 34 Q16 40 20 52' stroke='#7fc4e8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little wave sparkles -->
  <circle cx='6' cy='24' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='2' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='20' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
